personality_one_liner: A calm, reassuring, and data-driven interface that breathes, using generous whitespace, soft contrast, and clean grouped cards to highlight health metrics.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical spacing and comfortable iOS-native rhythms. Cards should never be flush to the screen edge. Use padding consistently.

do's: Use glass effect on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it.
Use frosted glass on sticky headers and bottom-sheet handles.
Apply subtle frosted overlays on featured goal cards if paired with imagery.
dont's: Do not apply glassmorphism to standard list rows, data input fields, or dense charts.
Do not stack more than two glass surfaces per screen.

screens.name: Onboarding/Auth
screens.purpose: Introduce the app's value proposition with a calming aesthetic and frictionless login (Email, Google, Apple).

states.loading: Centered brand-tinted spinner over the abstract gradient.
states.error: Standard iOS style alert for authentication failure.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a gradient-to-dark scrim. Value proposition text in large display typography at the bottom 40%, followed by full-width pill-shaped auth buttons (Google, Apple, Email). Ensure safe area padding at the bottom.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: A glanceable daily summary of calories, macros, water, steps, and weight.

states.loading: Skeleton cards mimicking the layout of the rings and charts.
states.empty: Clean UI showing 'Zero' states with encouraging text to start logging.
states.error: Error card with a retry button to fetch daily data.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll layout. Top section: 'Resumo Diário' with concentric macro rings or horizontal progress bars for Carbs, Protein, Fat. Below: 2-column grid for smaller metrics (Água, Passos, Sono) using surfaceSecondary cards with subtle shadow tier 1. Ensure generous md/lg gap between cards.

screens.name: Food Diary
screens.purpose: Chronological logging of daily meals (Café, Almoço, Jantar, Snacks) heavily featuring the 'AI Photo Scan' CTA.

states.empty: A beautiful food imagery placeholder (e.g., poke bowl) with a clear, primary CTA 'Escanear Refeição com IA'.
states.error: Toast or inline error if AI processing fails.

screens.layout: Camera-first flow emphasis. Sticky floating action button (FAB) at the bottom or a prominent top card for 'Scan Food'. Below: grouped lists (iOS style with surfaceSecondary bg) for each meal category. Each logged item shows a thumbnail, title, and macro breakdown.

screens.name: Weight/Body Tracking
screens.purpose: Visualize weight progress with Noom-inspired smoothed line charts and trend indicators.

states.empty: Illustration/Icon with a prompt 'Registre seu primeiro peso'.
states.error: Error state with a retry option to load historical data.

screens.layout: Large, edge-to-edge chart area on a surfaceSecondary card. The chart must display an actual weight line, a projected trend line, and a horizontal goal marker. Below the chart: a sticky or prominent input field/button to log today's weight. Recent history list at the bottom.

screens.name: Profile & Settings
screens.purpose: Manage user goals, app settings, and biometric preferences.
screens.layout: Standard iOS grouped list layout. Top section: User avatar (initials or photo) and name. Grouped sections (surfaceSecondary with border/divider) for Metas, Dispositivos (Wearables), and Conta.

onboarding_hero.alt: Soft colorful abstract calm gradient background

food_diary_placeholder.alt: Minimalist healthy poke bowl with fresh ingredients

fitness_empty_state.alt: Silhouette of a man running uphill

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'iOS-Native Clean' personality. Use soft shadows (tier 1), generous whitespace, and grouped cards.
BANNED: Do not use any shades of blue, indigo, or purple. Use the provided Sage Green/Moss color palette (#4A7258) for branding and trust.
For the Onboarding screen, implement a strict gradient-to-dark scrim over the background image (vertical, transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to ensure text legibility.
For the Weight Tracking chart, mimic the Noom style: show a smoothed line graph for actual weight, a dotted line for projected trend, and a horizontal goal line.
For the Food Diary, prioritize the AI scanning feature. Use a large, touch-friendly primary CTA (e.g., an AI Camera FAB).
All labels and strings must be in Portuguese (Brasil). E.g., 'Resumo Diário', 'Diário Alimentar', 'Progresso'.
Ensure all primary CTAs are sticky at the bottom with proper safe-area clearance.
Cards in a grid must use flex-wrap with space-between. Never leave a card orphaned stretching 50% width.
